notes.title: Reaper's Isle Full Release
notes.notes:
We've released our final update! (Probably) Check out what's new and improved in Reaper's Isle

• Unlocked player access to the lab
• Players can now finish the full story
• Fixes to the log system
• Cutscene at entrance to the Swamp reworked
• Fixed issues with subtitles and text pop-ups
• Audio improvements and additions
• Menu improvements and bug fixes 
• Other various bug fixes

We would have liked to include voice actors in our updates, but unfortunately, with our small team and no funding, this wasn't possible. (maybe someday!)

Thank you for playing Reaper's Isle. You can look forward to more games from Triple Cat Games in the future! 
This game started from a team of senior college students, but will continue as a duo dev team. We hope you'll grow with us and keep playing! 

Contact: https://www.reapersisle.com/contact/

notes.title: Reaper's Isle 2.2 Update!
notes.notes:
We've released an update! Check out what's new and improved in Reaper's Isle version 2.2

- Added option to skip cutscenes
- Updated subtitles
- Revamped script and dialogue
- Footstep sound effects
- Lighting updates
- Added introduction cutscene
- AI updates for Raptorex
- Menu changes
- Log updates
- New jump-scare sound effects
- Other various bug fixes

Please leave a note on our discussion board or contact us at https://www.reapersisle.com/contact/ if you encounter any issues or bugs while playing.

Thank you for playing Reaper's Isle, you can look forward to more updates soon. We anticipate adding new voice actors, major updates to the lab, and a very much upgraded phantom model!

notes.title: Reaper's Isle 2.1 Update!
notes.notes:
We've released an update! Check out what's new and improved in [b]Reaper's Isle version 2.1[/b]

- Fixed issue with invisible emergency lights
- More foliage added
- Made foliage use nanite for better performance
- Updated monsters ghost material
- Made the moon less potato shaped
- Fixed data layer and landscape loading bug
- Fixed a movement bug
- Improved cinematics
- Added emissive to lights
- New introduction cutscene 
- Added falling debris in lab
- Other various bug fixes

Please leave a note on our discussion board or contact us at  https://www.reapersisle.com/contact/ if you encounter any issues or bugs while playing. 

Thank you for playing Reaper's Isle, you can look forward to more updates soon. We anticipate adding new voice actors, (with a revised script), new and improved logs, and even a very much upgraded phantom model!
